name: Amee
description: '''Trần Huyền My''', also known as '''Amee''' (born 23 March 2000) is a [[Vietnamese people|Vietnamese]] singer. She first gained audiences attention in 2019 when she released her debut song "Anh Nhà Ở Đâu Thế" ("Boy, Where do you live?"). She is best known for being the first solo female artist from St.319 Entertainment. She was recognised as the "Best New Asian Artist in Vietnam" at the 2020 [[2020 Mnet Asian Music Awards|MAMA Awards]].
